name: zeffect_clone_runtime_entry_from_template
description: zEffect::CloneRuntimeEntryFromTemplate clones a runtime template entry, copies its effect node with clone options, stores the cloned node, discovers effect graphics user data, and returns the clone only when that data exists.
known_limits: tier S verification was not attempted in this session. Binary Ninja notes the original leaks the allocated clone when node copy or user-data lookup fails; the source preserves that caller-visible behavior.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja reconstruction and assembly for 0x462130 validate the -1 and null-template-node returns, 72-byte runtime-entry allocation/copy, CopyNodeWithCloneOptions call using g_zEffect_CloneCopyMode and g_zEffect_CloneCopyChildrenMode, clone->effectNode replacement, FindNodeUserDataRecursive call, effectGfxData storage, and null-or-clone return based on discovered user data.

The native clone smoke verifies the -1 guard, null-template-node guard, successful clone allocation distinct from the template entry, copied scalar fields, shared-node result, and effectGfxData discovery. zeffect_init_smoke covers the same clone path through runtime spawn and activation.
